history.overview: Hollows South is the primary Muramite assault route toward the Dranik Catacombs.

timeline.name: Mining Collapse
timeline.description: Dragorn miners abandoned the unstable southern caverns.

timeline.name: Muramite Advance
timeline.description: Muramite forces seized the caverns as a forward assault route.

timeline.name: Discord Ruptures
timeline.description: Discord energy tore open the stone, creating rupture fields.

timeline.name: Resistance Last Stand
timeline.description: Dragorn rebels established fallback alcoves to slow Muramite advances.
